description: This script automates testing of Git operations involving a superproject with a subproject, including setup, cloning, advancing the state, and fetching updates. It defines test cases for verifying submodules handling within a Git repository.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, setting up the environment or executing commands.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the mock clock used for testing time-dependent commands.
